name_vi: Hộp bộ chăm sóc râu du lịch
description_en: A narrow woven travel case with leather hinged flap and empty shaped fabric partitions for grooming tools. Canonical front: a rounded woven face and blank leather fastening loop. Side view: the narrow deep gusset and flap overlap. Rear view: a continuous woven back and two leather hinge strips. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A narrow woven travel case with leather hinged flap and empty shaped fabric partitions for grooming tools. Canonical front: a rounded woven face and blank leather fastening loop. Side view: the narrow deep gusset and flap overlap. Rear view: a continuous woven back and two leather hinge strips. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Royal: formal symmetry and graceful bound borders without emblems. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: plain over-one-under-one basket weave. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
